reviewNotes.fix: f1a7e4723 changes only scripts/import/bounded-question-reinforcement.ts. It moves the INSERT text into one BOUNDED_INSERT_SQL constant and the 12 parameters into boundedInsertParameters, keeping the same values in the same order. The only SQL change is $6 to $6::public.difficulty. In prisma/schema.prisma, Difficulty maps to the difficulty enum. problem_type, question_type and figure_source are varchar. source, pool, review_status and solution_source take the untyped SQL literals 'manual', 'shared', 'approved' and 'none', which PostgreSQL types from the column. The id and unit_id casts, the CAS, the reference stop, the journal and the approval gate are unchanged.
reviewNotes.tests: In my checkout at f1a7e4723, the three scripts/qa/bank tests pass (3 files, 21 tests). The PGlite fixture now declares the 5 real enum types. Its explicit PREPARE with $6 typed as text rejects an uncast INSERT, and a PREPARE of the real BOUNDED_INSERT_SQL with all-text parameters succeeds. Mutation: I removed ::public.difficulty and the apply/revert test failed with 'column "difficulty" is of type difficulty but expression is of type text', the same error as production. I then restored the file.
reviewNotes.readonlyPlans: plan-bounded-inserts.ts runs EXPLAIN (ANALYZE FALSE, FORMAT JSON) on the shared BOUNDED_INSERT_SQL with boundedInsertParameters. It does this inside a transaction set READ ONLY and asserts transaction_read_only = on. Result: 146 statements planned, 0 executed. Type errors such as 42804 are raised at parse/analysis time, so EXPLAIN catches them. Constraint, unique and FK checks run only at execution, and EXPLAIN does not cover them; the 0-current-UUID check and the CAS cover those. The plans used the R2 UUID ledger (the script defaults to bounded-final-r2). R3 differs from R2 only in id values, so the typing proof carries over.

limitations: No physical printer output. The teacher quick-answer grid wraps long native answers over several lines without clipping, with full solutions and rubrics after it; readability on paper is unverified.
The browser and A4 evidence (19 units, 107 pages) predates the two noun-only changes.
The read-only EXPLAIN proves parameter typing only; constraint, unique and FK behavior is first exercised by the real apply.
No claim of official curriculum alignment, learning effect, or mathematical verification of the whole bank.
